alpha.title: Readiness population
alpha.task: Quantify the actual Wayfinding Checklist control population. Submit total_controls, complete, incomplete, completion_percent (one decimal), critical_incomplete, and blocked (a list of control_id and service).

alpha.title: Service reconciliation
alpha.task: Reconcile every service-specific control and common ALL control. Submit services, one record for each of the five Move Matrix service IDs and ALL, with service_id, total, complete and incomplete. Do not allocate ALL controls to each service.

alpha.title: Critical work list
alpha.task: Identify all incomplete Critical-priority controls. Submit critical_incomplete, a list of records with control_id, service_id, owner and status.

alpha.title: Owner handover
alpha.task: Prepare the owner handover queue for every incomplete control. Submit owners, one record per owner with owner and control_ids. Include every incomplete control once.

alpha.title: Journey reconciliation
alpha.task: Reconcile the control population by journey stage. Submit journeys, one record per observed stage with journey_stage, total, incomplete and blocked. Use the source stage names.

alpha.title: Final readiness pack
alpha.task: Consolidate the earlier population, critical-work and ownership work into the final readiness pack. Submit total_controls, complete, incomplete, completion_percent, critical_incomplete_ids and blocked_ids.

beta.title: Blocked-control brief
beta.task: Identify every control marked Blocked. Submit blocked, a list with control_id, service, journey_stage and priority.

beta.title: Service impact
beta.task: Reconcile blocked controls against all five Move Matrix services and the common ALL group. Submit services, one record for each service ID and ALL, with service_id and blocked_ids, including empty lists.

beta.title: Blocked owner handoffs
beta.task: Prepare owner handoffs for every Blocked control. Submit blocked, a list with control_id, owner and due_date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

beta.title: Critical exception queue
beta.task: Build the complete incomplete-Critical queue for the next work session. Submit critical_incomplete, a list with control_id, service_id, owner and status.

beta.title: Return-journey follow-up
beta.task: Identify every incomplete control whose journey stage is Return Journey. Submit return_journey_incomplete, a list with control_id, service_id, owner, priority and status.

beta.title: Final exception pack
beta.task: Consolidate the prior blocked-control, critical-exception and return-journey work. Submit blocked_ids, critical_incomplete_ids and return_journey_incomplete_ids.
